newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville raises surplus power offers for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville raises surplus power offers for Tuesday.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) raised the price of surplus power offered for sale for Tuesday delivery, the agency said Monday.

Firm power delivered Tuesday during heavy load hours was offered at $22.50, with power to the Northwest valued at $23.00 and the California-Oregon Border (COB)/Nevada Oregon Border (NOB) set at $24.50, all with a 200 megawatt limit.
Non-firm power for Tuesday was offered at $21.25, with the Northwest priced at $22.00 and COB/NOB at $23.50 with a 400 megawatt limit.
BPA was offering Monday delivered firm power during heavy-load blocks at $20.00 in the Northwest and $21.50 at COB. Deliveries were limited to 300 megawatts, BPA had said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
